reviews.comment: Dr. Pentzer is an amazing professor! Her lectures were engaging but if you skip or miss lectures, you will fall behind. She posts her lecture notes on Canvas but the lectures don't have structure so it's hard to figure things out if you didn't attend. Her exam reviews were pretty similar to actual exams. Very test heavy so study ahead.

Dr Pentzer is a very intelligent individual, but an extremely poor choice for a professor. She was out-of-country for many of our lectures, and was even on a trip during our final exam. Her lectures were very disorganized, and almost every exam/practice exam had multiple errors (they also included barely-covered topics). Very frustrating class.

I loved her. She's very funny and makes jokes that relate to what's going on in social media currently, but uses them in a way that it makes the lecture stick. Sometimes the lectures could get monotone, but it was the end of the day and none of us would participate so it's not on her. Exams are very similar to the review!

Dr. Pentzer is great and super knowledgeable. She really understands her concepts and is good at explaining. Go to office hours. The only problem with her class is that there is a lack of structure - notes are just a few problems and there's nothing concrete to reference. Textbook doesn't really help. Practice exams are similar to real exam.

Dr. Pentzer was a great prof who is truly a charismatic figure and nice to end the week with. She's willing to cooperate with students. Though slightly complex, her lectures were quite interactive. The final was fair and very similar to the review. Double-check HW bc small mistakes impact your grade a lot. For final prep, do the review & redo HW

Great prof. SO clear about what is expected of you. Her lectures are great, and with the HW are sufficient to learn everything for the exams. Just do the work, pay attention, and you can easily get the A. 
She's also young and understands what being a student is, and is really inspirational with what she has accomplished at her age.

Dr. Pentzer is a really good professor, her lectures were pretty dull but she puts in a good effort with memes. The homework usually takes 1-2 hours a week on five questions, and most people score a 90-95 as the lecture slides cover them pretty well. The tests are relatively difficult with averages in the high C low B range, but they're reasonable.

An incredibly sweet professor, her lectures can drag on, but she ends class early pretty frequently. The homework's aren't too bad, but the exams can be tough. If you took OChem, it will help you a lot.

Dr. Pentzer brings a fun atmosphere to learning the material. She effectively teaches the material and assigns a fair amount of homework to cement the concepts in class. Her tests are challenging but fair. Would definitely take a course with her again.

Organic chemistry is very difficult and I definitely struggled, but Dr. Pentzer was a great prof and did her best despite the difficulties of being online. She cared about us and wanted us to succeed, and gave extra credit where needed. If you sign up for her, make sure you attend class and put in outside effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: So sweet, funny and caring! Even though it was a 100% zoom class, she taught us well and tried to provide as much material as we needed to get through the class. She gave us surprise extra credit and would double back over and over again to concepts we didn't understand
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Pentzer is a great professor but her teaching style was not for me. She went too fast and I couldnt keep up most of the time. She is a really helpful and caring but will make you work for your grade. The class was test heavy so you have to attend the lectures/watch them later.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Pentzer is a great professor. I'm honestly not doing well in the class and I wish I could just blame it on her, but organic chemistry is just tough. She really does her best to go above and beyond, plus she's very caring and funny. I would definitely recommend her, and don't be afraid to ask questions or for clarification.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super nice, she cares about her students and will always make time for them. She provides so much material to study and is able to explain things excellently. She is funny and a fair grader, as she is willing to give partial credit on exams and extra credit when nessessary. I would highly recommend this class to those who are ready to work.

Dr. Pentzer is an amazing professor that really wants to make sure that you understand the information. To do that, most of the time she will include a set of problems at the end of her notes that she'll answer (which might show up on HW/tests). Her tests and HW aren't too bad, but she only has 3 HW sets, 3 tests, and 1 final, so it all matters.
